name: Beta Announcement
voiceoverScript: Retro Vault Elite is still early, but it is moving fast because collector feedback is driving the updates.
Pricing, custom entries, IDs, speed work, and the trade beta are all being pushed forward in public.
If you collect, now is a good time to jump in and help shape it.

youtubeDescription: A short beta announcement cut for Retro Vault Elite, focused on recent collector-first updates and the early trade direction.
